note: The canon of WHAT CAN DO WHAT. agent-registry.json says who may act; protected-paths.json says where; doctrine-rules.json says what may be written. This file says WITH WHAT — one capability per row, one default tool per capability. Its purpose is to make 'find the right tool' an executable rule instead of a hope. A capability with no default is a GAP: that is a scouting target, not a licence to hand-roll it.
howToAddACapability: id            — stable, greppable. It appears in the routing verdict and in task packets.
capability    — plain English, phrased as the thing you are trying to DO, not the tool that does it.
default       — the ONE tool an agent routes to by default. null means GAP.
fallback      — what to use when the default is unavailable/over budget. null is allowed.
status        — 'canon' (proven here), 'candidate' (scout verdict Test, not yet proven), 'gap' (nothing chosen).
verdict       — scout vocabulary: Deploy | Test | Monitor | Ignore. Matches scout-diff.schema.json so a scout row can be promoted into this file without translation.
neverBuild    — plain sentence naming the from-scratch build this row forbids. This is the sentence a blocked agent reads.
escapeHatch   — the ONE legitimate reason to build instead of route. If none exists, say so.
costModel     — how this tool bills. The router cannot choose within a budget it cannot see.
evidence      — where in this workspace the choice is already proven. 'unproven' is an honest value.
canon         — the document that makes this a rule. Required. A routing verdict that cannot cite its authority will be argued with.

routingLaw.rule: Reuse what this workspace already ships. If nothing here does it, ROUTE to the canonical external tool for that capability. Only BUILD when the row's escapeHatch applies, and say which one in the packet.
routingLaw.whyThisExists: The consolidation doctrine ('reuse > rebuild; add no new dependency') is a bundle-weight rule that lives INSIDE one codebase. Read alone it tells an agent to hand-roll a video encoder rather than call a video service, which is the opposite of the intent. ROUTE is the missing middle step: calling a specialist service is not adding a dependency, it is declining to become one.

capabilities.capability: Turn a prompt or a still into moving footage
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not assemble a video generator out of a language model plus ffmpeg. A text model cannot generate footage; producing a slideshow and calling it video is the theater case this row exists to stop.
capabilities.escapeHatch: Deterministic screen-capture or chart-animation renders of OUR OWN app UI, where the content is data we own and no generative model is involved.
capabilities.costModel: per-second-of-output — confirm current rate before a batch run
capabilities.evidence: unproven — Marc-named 2026-08-25, no run record in this workspace

capabilities.capability: Speak written copy in a specific cloned or branded voice
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not wire a generic system TTS or a browser SpeechSynthesis call into anything customer-facing. It is the single loudest tell that a deliverable was not produced with intent.
capabilities.escapeHatch: Internal-only build alerts and local dev feedback where nobody outside the building hears it.
capabilities.evidence: referenced across research scouts and the Vapi voice lane
capabilities.canon: MODULE-CATALOG-v1.md M-003 (AI Call Qualifier — Vapi + Voice Clone)

capabilities.capability: Hold a real-time spoken phone conversation with a human
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not build a telephony loop out of raw Twilio media streams plus a model. Turn-taking, barge-in and latency budgets are the entire product here.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None. If Vapi cannot do it, scout a replacement; do not assemble one.

capabilities.capability: Put a talking human presenter on screen reading a script
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not attempt lip-sync or face animation in-house.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None.
capabilities.evidence: unproven — named in scout material only

capabilities.capability: Produce an original still image from a description
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not substitute a stock-photo URL, an emoji, or a CSS gradient for a commissioned image and present it as the deliverable.
capabilities.escapeHatch: Diagrams, charts and brand infographics are NOT this row — those are 'diagram-authoring' and 'charting', which are canon and must not be routed to an image model.

capabilities.capability: Cut, sequence, caption and master generated clips into one finished piece
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not treat generation as delivery. A pile of clips is not a video, and the assembly step is where most 'AI video' work actually fails.
capabilities.escapeHatch: Deterministic ffmpeg concatenation of OUR OWN renders with no creative decisions in it.

capabilities.capability: Turn recorded speech into accurate timestamped text
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not have a language model guess at audio content it cannot hear.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None.

capabilities.capability: Schedule and publish finished assets to social platforms, and read back what happened
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not hand-roll per-platform posting against undocumented endpoints. Each platform's auth and rate limits become permanent maintenance the moment they change.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None.

capabilities.capability: Render quantitative data as a chart inside a product surface
capabilities.default: recharts (via the TrendChart wrapper) + the existing CSS primitives
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not add a second charting library, and do not route a chart to an image model — a picture of a chart carries no real data and no honest empty state.
capabilities.escapeHatch: A chart type recharts genuinely cannot express, named explicitly in the packet.

capabilities.capability: Draw a bespoke brand diagram — journey, ecosystem, topology
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not introduce mermaid, react-flow or d3 for a static brand asset — auto-layout produces a generic look that reads as un-designed.
capabilities.escapeHatch: The diagram must become interactive or user-editable, which is a different product.

capabilities.capability: Produce a deck-grade or print-grade PDF from an HTML surface
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not add a PDF library. The workspace already has one canonical premium-export path.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None known.

capabilities.capability: Drive a real browser to test, screenshot, or visually verify a surface
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not assert that a UI works from reading its source. Visual claims need a real render.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None.
capabilities.evidence: in use across the workspace test suites

capabilities.capability: Run scheduled and event-driven multi-step automations between services
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not stand up a parallel automation plane. n8n and Make appearing in a plan is the known symptom of a session pulling a stale workflow doc — check APPS-CANON.md before acting on it.
capabilities.escapeHatch: A vendor integration that exists only in another plane, named in the packet.
capabilities.evidence: APPS-CANON.md — Garvis stack; heavy workspace usage
capabilities.canon: APPS-CANON.md — 'Workflow stacks are pinned per app'

capabilities.capability: Hold, rotate and distribute every credential
capabilities.neverBuild: Never place a credential in a repo file, a task packet, a ledger entry or a dashboard payload — not even redacted, not even temporarily.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None. This one is absolute.

capabilities.capability: Serve a static or JAMstack surface with functions
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not introduce a second static host for one project.
capabilities.escapeHatch: A platform capability Netlify lacks, named in the packet.
capabilities.evidence: APPS-CANON.md — Garvis, NorthLend live on Netlify

capabilities.capability: Run a long-lived server process or database
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not add a third hosting plane alongside Netlify and Railway.
capabilities.escapeHatch: A compliance or region requirement neither can meet.

capabilities.capability: Hold contacts, pipelines, and client-facing automation
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not build a CRM. Every vertical stack here is a GHL snapshot plus a custom surface on top — that is the product shape.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None.

capabilities.capability: Take money
capabilities.neverBuild: Never touch raw card data. Never build a payment flow that stores a PAN.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None.

capabilities.capability: Send a system-generated email to a human
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not send mail through a raw SMTP box from an app. Deliverability is the whole job.
capabilities.escapeHatch: Marketing sequences that belong in GHL, not here.

capabilities.capability: See what the models actually did — traces, cost, latency, failures
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not build a second trace store. The ledger records decisions; Langfuse records executions. They are different records and both are needed.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None.
capabilities.evidence: builder-control ledger carries an optional Langfuse trace id (Anti-Drift Rule 4)

capabilities.capability: Find, read and cite current external sources
capabilities.neverBuild: Never answer a research question from model memory and present it as sourced. Every research claim carries a URL or it is not a claim.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None.
capabilities.evidence: DANIEL runs this today without a pinned tool — the sourcing floor is 5 distinct sources per digest

capabilities.capability: Mirror decisions into a human-browsable memory outside the repo
capabilities.neverBuild: The mirror is human memory, never engineering authority. Never let an agent read a decision back OUT of the mirror and treat it as canon — canon lives in this repo.
capabilities.escapeHatch: None.
capabilities.evidence: unproven — AEGIS reports the mirror DISCONNECTED and the connector unauthorized as of 2026-08-25

capabilities.capability: Hold the visual source of truth for a bespoke interface
capabilities.fallback: the existing token system + 12 composer primitives
capabilities.neverBuild: Do not start a parallel design kit. The token system plus the 12 composers is the design system; a second one is a consolidation breach.
capabilities.escapeHatch: A brand-new brand with no relationship to the existing tokens.
